title: Sangathit Sanstha - Assistant Level Mock 1
description: Public Enterprise (Sangathit Sanstha) general knowledge and administrative mock test.

questions.questionText: What is the primary motive of a Public Enterprise (Sangathit Sanstha)?
questions.explanation: Unlike private companies, public enterprises are primarily established for public welfare and providing essential services.

questions.questionText: Who appoints the Board of Directors of a fully government-owned Public Enterprise in Nepal?
questions.explanation: The Government of Nepal (Council of Ministers) appoints the board members of fully state-owned enterprises.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a Public Enterprise in Nepal?
questions.explanation: NEA is a fully government-owned public enterprise responsible for electricity generation and distribution.

questions.questionText: What is the standard working hours per week as per the Labor Act of Nepal?
questions.explanation: The Labor Act stipulates a maximum of 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week as standard working hours.
GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product, which measures the total monetary value of all final goods and services produced within a country.
